org.name: Research Organisation
org.description: Small research team that gathers source material, synthesises findings, and publishes structured analysis reports.

sections.title: Charter
sections.body:
## Mission
- Focus area: {domain_focus}
- Every research doc cites at least {min_sources} sources.
- Reports are structured: Overview, Findings, Implications, Open Questions.

sections.title: Process
sections.body:
1. Researcher gathers material and writes research docs.
2. Analyst synthesises research into a final report.
3. Both auto-save their outputs.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Gather source material on a topic and write a structured research document.
workflow: Restate the topic in one paragraph.
Gather at least the configured minimum number of sources.
Draft a research doc with sections: Background, Findings, Sources.

save_rule.name_pattern: snake_case slug for the topic — no count, no date
save_rule.title_pattern: Title Case with spaces — no count, no date

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Synthesise existing research docs into a structured analysis report with implications and open questions.
workflow: List the available research docs on the topic.
Draft a report with sections: Overview, Findings, Implications, Open Questions.

save_rule.name_pattern: snake_case slug — no count, no date
save_rule.title_pattern: Title Case with spaces — no count, no date

teams.name: Research Team
teams.description: Two-agent unit that owns the full path from raw sources to a published analysis report. The analyst coordinates: it decides what's worth synthesising and pulls in the researcher when more primary material is needed.

workflows.name: Research Pipeline
workflows.description: Sequential pipeline: researcher gathers material, then analyst publishes a report.

app.name: Test Org
app.description: Small research team for testing the agentorg renderer end-to-end.

empty_state.title: Pick an agent or workflow
empty_state.body: Try the research pipeline or chat directly with the analyst.

knowledge_empty.documents: No knowledge yet — run the researcher first.

researcher.description: Gathers source material; writes research docs.

researcher: Research the impact of agno on the agent framework landscape
Summarise key sources on autonomous coding agents
analyst: Analyse the research docs on agent frameworks
Draft an implications report from the latest research
